teile.name: Intro
teile.szene: A cluttered desk with stacks of research papers. Light filters through a window, highlighting a laptop screen. The AI‑generated voice narrates, easing the overwhelm.
teile.bildtext: Notebook filled with glowing AI icons
teile.text: Tired of endless research piles? Gemini Notebook distills papers into bite‑sized AI summaries for you today.

teile.name: Upload
teile.szene: User drags a PDF into the notebook interface. The screen shows a progress bar and a voice icon. Background music is calm.
teile.text: Upload PDFs, let Gemini scan, and listen to audio overviews that match your study rhythm daily.

teile.name: Run Code
teile.szene: A code cell opens on the notebook. Lines of Python appear as the AI runs them, producing a graph instantly.
teile.text: Run code straight in a notebook; analyze datasets, plot charts, and see results instantly right there.

teile.name: Sync
teile.szene: A phone, tablet, and laptop display the same notebook page. The icons sync in real time.
teile.text: Sync notes across Gemini app, Search, and Chrome so every device stays up‑to‑date everywhere now.

teile.name: Enterprise
teile.szene: An office setting with a team reviewing a shared notebook. A banner indicates enterprise licensing.
teile.text: Enterprise plans unlock premium models; individuals gain access via Google One AI Premium subscriptions today.

teile.name: Limits
teile.szene: A warning icon flashes as code runs. The user checks the output for accuracy.
teile.text: Remember code execution is beta; double‑check outputs before sharing, as errors can still surface today.

teile.name: Engage
teile.szene: The screen fades to a call‑to‑action overlay. Background music crescendos.
teile.text: Be sure to like, share and save this video.

entwurf.beschreibung: Gemini Notebook empowers researchers with AI summaries, code execution, and seamless sync across devices, while outlining its enterprise options and beta limitations.
